name: Declared Entity Identifier Check
description: Each uploaded file and record must contain a declared entity identifier (cse_id).

name: Alert Identifier Uniqueness
description: Alert IDs must be globally unique within an entity and reporting period.

name: Closure Monotonicity
description: closed_at cannot occur chronologically before created_at.

name: Acknowledgement Monotonicity
description: acknowledged_at cannot occur chronologically before created_at.

name: Case Referential Integrity
description: Cases linked to alerts must resolve to existing alert records.

name: Escalation Referential Integrity
description: Escalations linked to cases must reference existing valid cases.

name: Severity Value Validity
description: Alert and case severities must be one of Critical, High, Medium, Low.

name: Asset Inventory Resolution
description: Asset references in alerts must resolve to known assets in the entity inventory.

name: Duplicate Record Deduplication
description: Duplicate rows across alert or case records are flagged or merged.

name: Malformed Record Isolation
description: Unparseable timestamps and malformed columns must be quarantined.

name: Source File Provenance Preservation
description: Source file SHA-256 hash and upload metadata must be computed and retained.

name: Reporting Completeness Audit
description: System evaluates expected mandatory field completeness across all tables.
